title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: In the context of one-hot encoding, the variable $$'meat=beef'$$ is $$1$$ if the meat is beef and $$0$$ otherwise. This helps in distinguishing between different categories of meat in the regression model.

title: Interpreting the Box Plot
text: Look at the box plot to compare the total cost associated with different types of meat. Which type of meat tends to have a higher total cost?

title: Comparing Costs for Different Meats
text: The box plot shows that beef tends to have a lower total cost compared to fish. This suggests that the presence of beef might decrease the total cost, leading to a negative weight for $$'meat=beef'$$.
